q: Loop ka counter variable baar-baar use hona kaunsi locality ka example hai?
explain: Temporal locality: jo data abhi use hua wo thodi der mein phir use hone wala hai, jaise loop counter.

q: Virtual machine aur container (Docker) mein main farq kya hai?
options: VM halki hoti hai container se
Container apna poora OS chalata hai
VM pura guest OS chalati hai, container host kernel share karta hai
explain: VM mein har instance ka apna poora guest OS hota hai (bhari); container host OS ka kernel share karta hai (halka, tez).

q: Permission string -rwxr-xr-- ka octal value kya hai?
explain: owner rwx=7, group r-x=5, others r--=4 -> 754.

q: Bade data transfer ko CPU ki madad ke bina seedhe memory se/tak move karne ke liye kya use hota hai?
explain: DMA (Direct Memory Access) controller khud data move karta hai; CPU sirf shuru aur ant mein involve hota hai.

q: 32-bit address space maximum kitni memory address kar sakta hai?
explain: 2^32 bytes = 4 GB; 4 GB se zyada RAM use karne ke liye 64-bit OS chahiye.
